### Registry declaration and map construction — 2026-10-20

[passed partial source review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/utility-mute-map-initialization-review.json).
Three retained records/43literal occurrences are not all native references.
One new complete function10147ef4c (10297Cbytes) invokes each reached metadata
entry's+40callback, optionally+48, then on a later pass walks its descriptor
list and attempts+88map population through10148d148, storing the descriptor
in returnedentry+18. Intervening10147f568, exact key/insertion semantics,
actual node/registry membership and startup invocation remain qualified.

The separate [12-byte wrapper query](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/queries/utility-mute-registration-wrapper-register-frontier-2026-10-20.json)
[passed independent raw-data review](../../analysis/ableton-live-12.4.3/full-spec-v1/reviews/utility-mute-registration-wrapper-register-review.json).
Exact10147e7c4..e7cf is LDRB W8,[SP], STRB W8,[SP], then non-link branch to
10147e458. Conditional on reaching that branch with valid ordinary stable
stack memory, receiverX0/callbackX5 andSP remain unchanged. X8 changes and
one stack byte is read/written; no all-register/no-stack-traffic claim or proof
of caller assignments/actual invocation. Root checked the pinned image,
header/segments and only those12instruction bytes as data.

These narrow registered declaration-to-map construction. Actual mpMute key/node
admission, wrapperD+350 versus childD+358, created unit and processor/public
Mute delivery remain unknown. All38application scenarios stayU; no signal law,
feasibility/no-route finding, case or grade. This branch is stopped at these
boundaries; no further callee/word or original execution selected.

This removes only that wrapper-local register-preservation uncertainty, not caller assignment or invocation.

This does not yet equate any current list node with that declaration or wrapperD350withchildD358.
accepted_existing_scope.relationship: Reviewer authored the retained registry/wrapper queries and this proposal; Root independently reviewed those prior results. This is an author navigation judgment, not a new independent review of own source claims.

symbols.M: same metadata receiver whose address is DAT106e6e618
symbols.N: specific descriptor node reached in M list after10147f568, independently bound to the mpMute/350 declaration
symbols.K: the actual key representation associated with N+0x40, not assumed equal to the wide literal mpMute or child label Mute

smallest_missing_predicate.conditional_target: For that same stable M and N, the helper returns an entry E in M+88 indexed/equated by the intended K; the immediate caller store E+18=N therefore makes lookup by the SAME key representation yield that same descriptor, subject to later mutations.
smallest_missing_predicate.not_enough: Proving only generic insert/find behavior for an arbitrary K does not bind mpMute. Proving descriptor provenance without matching key equality also does not close admission. A rendered zero kernel or callback label is not evidence of this predicate.
separate_premises_not_to_launder: The current descriptor N survives10147f568 preprocessing and is actually the node created by the mpMute/350 declaration helper.
The lookup path supplies an equivalent key under the same comparator/normalization, without assuming literalmpMute equals exposedchildMute.
Registration and initialization actually execute on the relevant model instance; the registry entry is present, callbacks stable, helper allocations return and relevant objects/maps remain valid.
No later duplicate key/replacement/erase changes E+18 before the binder lookup.
Admission of the model-side node is still not proof of D358child identity, createdunit/processor descriptor or publicMute control delivery.

frontier_assessment.why: The already retained call site explicitly supplies M+88 as receiver, derives local_80 from N+40 immediately before the call, passes its address again, and immediately installs N at returned E+18. The helper lies exactly between descriptor-key-associated input and value installation. It is a more direct candidate than generic names/type prefixes/buffers/allocators.
what_a_small_body_could_resolve: Whether the helper searches/creates an entry and what key-associated value is actually read/copied/compared.
Whether its return value is the container entry whose+18field the caller overwrites.
Which guard or duplicate-key branch controls existing-entry versus insertion behavior.
Whether key semantics are locally explicit or immediately delegated to opaque context.
what_it_cannot_resolve_alone: Actual runtime initializer caller/order or registry presence.
The mpMute declaration→N identity across descriptor construction and preprocessing.
Equivalence to the actual binder lookup key if key construction/comparison lies elsewhere.
Model-to-processor signal/control join or any public Mute/UI/audio law.
frontier_assessment.why_stop_if_opaque: If the complete selected helper only forwards a generic argument to another unread key/comparator/allocation/template operation without exposing its semantics, report that exact callee/operand and stop. Names alone cannot turn it into a closed key-admission path; no recursive generic framework chase follows automatically.

one_proposed_selection.permitted_if_root_separately_selects: Read this complete body as data only and retain exact source row/chunk/code hashes and warnings. Determine argument-to-key/entry predicates from its actual operations, qualifying ABI/decompiler uncertainty.
one_proposed_selection.stopping_condition: After this one body—or earlier size/partial/opaque-argument boundary—report the exact remaining key/equality/return-node dependency. No callee/word/caller/index scan, initializer recursion or generic name/type/buffer/allocator branch. Any further selection requires a new Root instruction.
one_proposed_selection.priority_reason: Direct key/entry construction is the smallest currently named uncertainty at the map-population callsite; a successful local proof would narrow the next missing predicate without pretending to finish admission.

decision_on_current_branch: Do not declare infeasible/no-route. Existing source supports a conditional population path and a concrete selected next edge, while runtime/key/mpMute-node obligations remain unknown. The branch stops now until Root explicitly selects the one proposed body.

Prior full registry/wrapper/declaration/core reads are carried with exact immutable provider identities; no new raw export record, function body, metadata, image word or lookup helper inspected in this proposal.
